title: Cash Register (Cha-Ching)
blurb: Cha-ching — the mechanical cash register bell that means money has changed hands. The internet's sound for profit in every form: a good deal, a paycheck hitting, a scheme coming together. Streamers fire it on donations; editors use it when anyone so much as mentions money. Satisfying, greedy, and universally understood in any language.
origin: The classic mechanical register bell, meme shorthand for profit.
